title: dfs-signals-digest
universal_lens: DFS market microstructure is modeled as a high-dimensional convex optimization over a discrete simplex. The joint distribution of player ownership, salary constraints, and contest payout structures forms a constrained measure space where optimal lineups correspond to extremal points maximizing expected utility under variance penalties.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps the DFS signal digest into a conformal prediction framework. Ownership projections and narrative mentions serve as non-conformity scores, while historical calibration tables provide the empirical quantiles required to bound future lineup performance with rigorous finite-sample guarantees.
gse_mapping: GSE translates the static slate census into dynamic state transitions. Contest fill rates and field caps act as environmental feedback loops, driving real-time adjustments in leverage spots and chalk anchors as the aggregate user base reacts to public narratives.

reasoning_traces.think:
The DFS signal digest operates as a multi-layered data pipeline extracting structural priors from live market microstates. At the foundational level, the contest census defines the geometric boundaries of the optimization problem—specifically, the discrete simplex of valid lineups constrained by salary caps and positional requirements. The primitives extracted here do not merely describe data; they actively parameterize the objective function for portfolio construction. The narrative ownership signal serves as an exogenous forcing term, shifting the probability mass toward 'chalk' configurations. This creates a predictable drift in the aggregate user base's strategy space. Simultaneously, the leverage stack correlation operator identifies the residual variance unexplained by these public narratives. By isolating the covariance structure of player performances, we can construct orthogonal portfolios that exploit the mispricing induced by narrative-driven herding. The mathematical duality lies between the primal problem of maximizing expected points and the dual problem of minimizing exposure to high-ownership, low-variance outcomes. Failure modes emerge when the correlation model assumes stationarity in a highly non-stationary environment, such as sudden weather changes or late-breaking injuries, causing the leverage spots to collapse into chalk. Thus, the robust derivation requires continuous recalibration of the correlation kernel against real-time telemetry.

reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: This formalism traces its lineage to the Kelly Criterion in gambling theory, extended into high-dimensional combinatorial optimization via modern portfolio theory. The specific application to DFS mirrors the evolution of quantitative arbitrage in traditional equity markets, where information asymmetry is rapidly compressed by algorithmic traders. The integration of natural language processing (via RSS feeds) into the ownership prior reflects the broader convergence of sentiment analysis and stochastic control in financial engineering.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: The opposing agents in this ecosystem are predominantly retail users exhibiting bounded rationality, heavily influenced by salient media narratives and heuristic-based lineup construction. They systematically overvalue high-profile players (chalk) and undervalue complex correlation structures. The sovereign primitive suite models this cognitive bias as a predictable distortion in the probability distribution, allowing the quantitative engine to adopt a contrarian stance. By anticipating the herd's gravitational pull toward safe assets, the system strategically allocates capital to the periphery of the lineup space, capturing excess returns generated by the crowd's failure to internalize second-order correlation effects.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: A critical veto condition arises when the narrative signal becomes collinear with the fundamental performance drivers, eliminating the informational edge. If every leverage spot identified by the correlation model is simultaneously highlighted in the public RSS feeds, the ownership projection will spike, transforming a contrarian play into a chalk anchor. Furthermore, leakage between the contest shape layer and the payout structure must be monitored; if the largest fields are dominated by a single, highly correlated strategy, the effective variance of the entire market collapses. The system must dynamically veto any primitive output that exhibits high mutual information with the aggregate market consensus, ensuring that the deployed strategies remain truly orthogonal to the dominant eigenmodes of the user base.
